item.title: ICC World Cup: India, Australia, Pakistan in same group; Bangladesh face England in first match
item.description:
The ICC announced the 2027 Cricket World Cup schedule. Hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, it runs 2 October–21 November.
India open against Australia in Cape Town on 7 October, then face Pakistan in Johannesburg three days later. Virat Kohli said this will be his last World Cup.
Australia captain Pat Cummins said playing India is huge and they will seek revenge for the 2023 final. The final is on 21 November. (via en.prothomalo.com) #Zimbabwe #ZimbabweNews
